name: Rothenburg ob der Tauber
tagline: The medieval walled town of the Romantic Road
summary: Rothenburg ob der Tauber is Germany's best-preserved medieval walled town. Walk the covered ramparts, photograph the half-timbered Plönlein corner, climb the town hall tower, join the Night Watchman's funny evening tour and visit the year-round Christmas shop.
seasonNote: Busy with day-trippers in summer; the December Christmas market is magical.
arrival: Regional trains from Würzburg or Nuremberg with one or two changes, about 1h30 to 2h; on the Romantic Road by car.
gettingAround: Walk everything; the walled town is small.
cashTip: Carry some cash: many small restaurants and bakeries still prefer it. Round up or tip 5 to 10 percent.
foodTip: Schneeballen (snowball pastries), Franconian sausages and Franconian wine.
